def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    seen, comps = set(), []
    for r in range(h):

            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); pts.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:

            comps.append((color,pts))
    # Locate the largest L-shaped guide and recolor the nearest compact object

    guides=[]

        ys=[y for y,x in pts]; xs=[x for y,x in pts]
        y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs); s=set(pts)
        if len(pts)>=6 and any(

            all((y,xx) in s for y in range(y0,y1+1))

            guides.append((color,pts))
    if not guides:

    color,guide=max(guides,key=lambda x:len(x[1]))
    ys=[y for y,x in guide]; xs=[x for y,x in guide]
    cy,cx=max(ys),max(xs) # corner for north/east L in this test
    opts=[]
